verdict.summary: The change implements the intended asymmetric concurrency policy without weakening the quarantine path: only `labeled` events share the repository-wide debounce group and preserve the active run, while `unlabeled` and every other declared trigger retain per-issue groups with cancellation. The self-test reads both expressions and the trigger set from the workflow, evaluates every declared event against independently stated expected results, exercises the pre-change and over-collapsed regression shapes, and fail-closes on unsupported syntax. The added evaluator covers the operators and `format()` form actually used by this seam, and its refusal tests include positive and negative controls. I found no correctness, security, or test-validity defect in the diff.
